description: AI guardrail policy. Consumed by tools/Test-Guardrail.ps1 (preToolUse hook and git pre-commit). Methodology is governed here, Git is only transport.
modeHelp: enforce = actions as configured | ask = deny becomes ask | warn = everything only logged | off = disabled. Override per session with env LCM_GUARDRAIL_MODE.
askSupportedHelp: false converts every 'ask' into a deny whose reason tells the agent to call ask_user first, then request a grant.

budget.reason: Large number of file edits in one session. Confirm the plan is still on track before spending more credits.

rules.reason: Retired folders .lcm/.lcd must not be created (structure.lock.json). Use LCM_Inventory, LCM_AI or LCM_Shared.
Shell command would create or stage a retired .lcm/.lcd path.
